links.outcome: Gap between benchmark-selected LLM performance and expert-rated real-world oncology performance
links.effect: Models chosen on established benchmarks showed modest overall performance on MTB-preparation questions; authors describe a gap between benchmark and real-world performance.
links.quote: Common issues include outdated information and confident presentation of misinformation, which indicates a gap between benchmark- and real-world performance.

links.outcome: Outdated, incomplete, or factually incorrect clinical content in LLM answers to oncology questions
links.effect: A large percentage of answers contained outdated or incomplete information as well as factual errors; overall performance was modest.
links.quote: Our findings identified significant issues, where a large percentage of answers contained outdated or incomplete information, as well as factual errors.

links.outcome: Confident presentation of incorrect information by LLMs
links.effect: Confident presentation of misinformation was a common issue across the tested medium-scale models.
links.quote: Common issues include outdated information and confident presentation of misinformation, which indicates a gap between benchmark- and real-world performance.

unlisted_practices: On-premise deployment of medium-scale open-source LLMs on consumer-grade hardware to protect sensitive data
Inter-rater agreement and rater confidence assessment when evaluating LLM answers

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and safety of responses from medium-scale open-source LLMs on molecular tumor board questions evaluated by clinical experts, finding high rates of outdated information and confident misinformation.
